latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Subtitle Generator for Video.

- Instantly generate and embed captions for videos up to 3 minutes, with export to 1080p MP4 and other formats.
- Simple workflow: upload your video, describe the result you want, and receive captioned files in under a minute.
- No timeline editing or export settings required; all rendering is done server-side.
- Supports session management, anonymous or authenticated access, and provides 100 free credits valid for 7 days.
- Cloud GPU backend processes uploads, subtitle generation, video rendering, and export.
- Automatic error handling and workarounds for common issues (file type, size, credits).
- Clear setup and usage instructions for new users.
